scope: Selected primary-source milestones, not a systematic census or a pooled regression dataset.

definitions.year: Publication year unless date_basis explicitly states otherwise.
definitions.sites: Nominal contacts within the stated denominator; may include stimulation or reference contacts.
definitions.simultaneous_channels: Stated acquisition capacity or reported simultaneous recording count; interpretation is specified per row. Not a count of working neurons.
definitions.null: Not extracted or not established by the cited source; not zero.

milestones.name: NET-50
milestones.evidence: peer-reviewed device design and animal study
milestones.note: Alternative NET-10 has 4 sites. Cohort total of 16 probes/80 working electrodes across 7 mice is not a per-animal baseline.

milestones.name: Parallel implantation NET
milestones.note: Typical devices span 32-128 contacts and 4-8 shanks; 128 is the upper design value, not a per-animal demonstrated maximum.

milestones.name: Modular NET implant
milestones.note: Primary paper reports 2304 simultaneously monitored channels; an author review reports 1930 channels for the 144-shank example. The relationship is not explicitly reconciled; do not infer working yield from the difference.

milestones.name: 5376-channel recording platform
milestones.evidence: peer-reviewed hardware with rat surface-field validation
milestones.note: External headstage; human-scale array design does not establish human implantation. Separate modality from penetrating NET.

milestones.name: Neuropixels 1.0
milestones.note: Selected sites acquired concurrently; units can be recorded across multiple sites.

milestones.name: Neuropixels 2.0 single shank
milestones.note: Do not substitute four-shank site count in a single-shank comparison.

milestones.name: Neuropixels 2.0 four shanks
milestones.note: Four times the shanks of single-shank version; still 384 simultaneous channels in original design.

milestones.name: Neuropixels Ultra
milestones.note: Final paper specification; earlier 2023 preprint and 6528-site project-page variant are not interchangeable.

milestones.name: Neuropixels 2.0 Quad Base
milestones.note: Larger base expands simultaneous channels. Publication date and commercial availability are separate milestones.

milestones.name: Argo
milestones.evidence: peer-reviewed electronics capacity, partially populated in-vivo experiments
milestones.note: Over 30000 simultaneous sheep surface-LFP channels; capacity 65536 not fully populated in-vivo. Separate rat experiment yielded 791 isolated units.

milestones.name: BISC wireless subdural interface
milestones.note: Selectable subset of up to 1024 channels. Reported periods up to 2 weeks pigs/up to 2 months behaving NHP; not chronic human validation.

milestones.name: Neuralink System B
milestones.note: Paper reports >3000 implanted electrodes recorded concurrently; separate illustrated System A has 1280 implanted and 1020 acquired channels.

milestones.date_basis: first human implantation; specification from PRIME brochure
milestones.name: N1
milestones.evidence: company device specification and first-human announcement
milestones.note: Fully implanted wireless architecture; nominal sites do not establish participant-specific working/simultaneous channels.

milestones.name: BrainGate motor BCI
milestones.note: Physical sensor has 100 electrodes; 96 available for neural recording (Fig.1b). Publication date is not implantation date.

milestones.name: Speech BCI, participant T12
milestones.note: Four 64-contact arrays implanted; principal speech decoding used two area 6v arrays. Implanted and decoded counts differ.

milestones.name: Rapidly calibrating speech BCI
milestones.note: Distinct study from Willett 2023; not an annual product generation.

milestones.name: Layer7 four-array intraoperative recording
milestones.note: Temporary procedure; not demonstrated chronic 4096-channel speech BCI or 4096 neurons.

milestones.name: Layer7 design and first five human recordings
milestones.subjects: human / separate animal and cadaver tests
milestones.evidence: peer-reviewed contact design and acute human recordings
milestones.note: Nominal 1024 includes distinct contact roles. First five human recordings were at most 15 minutes after conventional craniotomy.

milestones.date_basis: specification access date, not product introduction
milestones.name: Connexus module
milestones.subjects: specification; human trial event separately documented
milestones.note: First chronic Connect-One implantation announced 2026-06-17; announcement did not establish participant-specific electrode count.420 appears in a separate analysis.

milestones.name: Stentrode SWITCH study
milestones.note: Population-level sensing in a vessel;16 contacts is not 16 isolated neurons or commands.
